effect_description_eng:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may link 1 Digimon card with the [Social], [Navi] or [Tool] trait from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon with the link cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng:
Link Requirements [Link] [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 
(Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
xros_req:
[App Fusion] [Gatchmon] & [Navimon] & [Tweetmon]: Cost 0
If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.
